title: Latest News, Breaking News Today - Entertainment, Cricket, Business, Politics - India Today
content:
Rahul Gandhi's comments repeated allegations that he had made earlier in the day during a Parliament debate. His remarks had triggered protests from the government and demands that he prove what he was alleging.

Donald Trump on Wednesday said he will order heavy strikes on Iran in retaliation for surprise attack on US forces overnight, which punctured a pause in fighting.

Thousands of farmers have marched to the outskirts of Madhya Pradesh's capital Bhopal, and are planning to march to CM Mohan Yadav's residence. In the protest march over moong procurement policies of the state government, the protesting farmers received support from several GenZ individuals.

Johnson & Johnson has agreed to a proposed $5.5 billion settlement in US lawsuits over its talc-based baby powder. The case does not directly affect India, but it brings wider attention to the country's unresolved asbestos use.

CJP is facing questions over its poor response to exam controversies in Punjab and Jharkhand after leading the NEET agitation. The contrast has sharpened allegations of selective focus. The scrutiny is all the more significant as Punjab heads to the Assembly polls early next year.

Commonwealth Games 2026 Live, July 29: India's boxing campaign is gathering momentum as Sakshi has guaranteed a medal by reaching the semi-finals, while Arundhati Choudhary is battling for another podium finish. On the track, Animesh Kujur is progressing to the men's 200m semi-finals with a season's best run, while Tajinderpal Singh Toor and Samardeep Singh Gill are advancing to the shot put final. Earlier, Sanjana is missing out on a weightlifting medal.

Police recovered several crores in cash and kilograms of gold from the residence of a former government bus driver in West Bengal's Birbhum district, with the counting of notes still underway.

The Centre has told Parliament that NavIC cannot currently provide standalone positioning services because only three PNT satellites are operational. ISRO is preparing NVS-03 for launch.

At 25, IIM Bangalore student Zaid Khan has built an estimated Rs 5 crore business. The Zedital Media founder says aspiring entrepreneurs should start small, build confidence through selling, and create a strong digital presence because "content is digital currency."

Rahul Gandhi criticised the anti-paper leak amendment bill as a "band-aid when you need surgery", arguing it fails to address the root causes of exam irregularities, and claimed he was prevented from speaking in the Lok Sabha for targeting Amit Shah.

What seemed like an inexpensive Thailand holiday turned into a week-long kidnapping ordeal for three Indian nationals. Investigators say the survivors were lured to Thailand by a gang comprising Indian and Pakistani nationals with a fake tour package, tortured into demanding ransom from their families, and held captive until Thai police tracked down the hideout.

WhatsApp has announced browser-based voice and video calling on WhatsApp Web without requiring the desktop app. The update also introduces a new call transfer feature for seamless switching between devices.

Take a break from news and test your vocab. Can you guess the word in 6 tries?

Netflix's Musafir Cafe starring Vikrant Massey, Vedika Pinto and Mahima Makwana is currently all over social media. And guess what, the cafe is actually a decades-old retreat.

Jan Suraaj founder Prashant Kishor has accused the BJP-led NDA of using an AI-generated video of former Bihar CM Nitish Kumar to influence voters in the high-stakes Bankipur Assembly bypoll. With the contest now at the corner, Kishor said, if the BJP proved the video was genuine, he would withdraw his candidature.

The government told Parliament that no defect was found in the fuel control switch of the Air India Boeing 787-8 that was grounded in February. It has renewed attention on fuel switches, which are at the centre of the probe into the Ahmedabad crash.

As Maharashtra's FDA continues its crackdown on hygiene violations at hotels, restaurants and clubs, the Bombay High Court on Wednesday questioned whether licence suspensions were being imposed too readily, saying authorities must take a "realistic view" while safeguarding public health.

Sonu Sood criticised Kangana Ranaut's 'Generation Gutter' remark about Gen Z protesters. He said public figures must weigh their words carefully because young people shape public support.

The inspections found widespread food safety violations, including cockroach infestation, poor sanitation, unsafe storage, improper food handling and licencing lapses.

The legislation was passed amid Opposition sloganeering after a stormy exchange over Rahul Gandhi's remarks on police action against student protesters. Introduced by Union Minister Jitendra Singh on July 27 following the CJP-led protests that forced Dharmendra Pradhan's resignation, the Bill now awaits passage in the Rajya Sabha.

Rahul Gandhi targeted Home Minister Amit Shah in the Lok Sabha over the alleged crackdown on student protesters, triggering protests from NDA MPs, disruptions in the House and a sharp exchange with the Treasury benches.

A bizarre finger-clicking allegation has rocked the North Yorkshire and South Durham Cricket League. The man nicknamed "Clicky Ponting" now finds himself at the centre of cricket's strangest cheating investigation.

CJP leaders met farmer leader Rakesh Tikait in Delhi to discuss a joint platform for farmers, students and youngsters. The outreach signals wider agitation as the outfit presses for the withdrawal of FIRs against student protesters who participated in the Jantar Mantar protest.

Mahua Moitra warned that after student protests and Dharmendra Pradhan's resignation, the government would suffer further blows if it continued ignoring public concerns and refusing to listen.

Isro satellite images and IMD data confirm the Deep Depression is weakening as it moves inland, with no new vortex forming over the Bay of Bengal or Arabian Sea. Here is what it means for monsoon rain in the coming days.
